name: Lorcaserin Hydrochloride

examples.title: Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Belviq XR® in Conjunction With Lifestyle Modification for Weight Loss in Obese Adolescents,…
examples.why: Study was terminated as Eisai agreed to voluntarily withdraw Belviq XR from US market.

summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave Lorcaserin Hydrochloride a low risk score of 40 for the liver [M]. The same computer model gave the drug a high risk score of 69 for the heart [M]. In addition, a clinical study testing Belviq XR for weight loss in obese adolescents was ended early because Eisai agreed to voluntarily take Belviq XR off the United States market [4].
